t: Use a Connector to attach a cable network to a block or machine. Open the Connector to name it and control whether it is enabled.
使用连接器将线缆网络接入方块或机器。打开连接器GUI可为其命名，并控制其启用状态。
Advanced Connectors support higher internal energy capacity and more demanding setups. They are configured in the same way as normal connectors.
高级连接器支持更高的内部能量容量及更复杂的配置需求。其配置方式与普通连接器完全一致。
Routing Connectors are for routing networks. Use them with routing cables when linking networks through Routers or Wireless Routers.
路由连接器专用于路由网络。在通过路由器或无线路由器连接网络时，请配合路由网络线缆使用。
